title: SK Hynix — Not Nvidia — Has Become the Most Important AI Chip Stock on the Planet
excerpt: Nvidia still builds the chips powering the AI revolution, but a quiet South Korean memory maker has quietly become the stock Wall Street is betting on most a...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • SK Hynix (SKHY) supplies the high-bandwidth memory bottlenecking every AI accelerator, shifting the AI investment narrative away from Nvidia's GPUs.

  • Leveraged ETFs tied to SK Hynix hold $5.5 billion in assets, topping Nvidia's $4.8 billion and making AI memory Wall Street's hottest speculative trade.

  • Daily rebalancing in leveraged ETFs can rapidly magnify losses during volatile markets, making them poor vehicles for long-term AI memory exposure.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and SK Hynix didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Artificial intelligence investing has entered a new phase. For the past two years, the conversation revolved around Nvidia's (NASDAQ:NVDA) graphics processors because they powered the AI revolution. Today, the bottleneck has shifted. The limiting factor is no longer how many GPUs companies can design, but how much high-bandwidth memory (HBM) they can attach to them. 

That shortage has pushed AI memory prices higher, lifted memory stocks to record valuations, and changed where speculative capital is flowing. Increasingly, the market's attention isn't centered on Nvidia anymore. It has moved to SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY), the South Korean company supplying the memory every AI accelerator now depends upon.

AI's New Bottleneck Is Memory, Not GPUs

Nvidia still dominates AI accelerators, but every one of its flagship chips depends on stacks of HBM to deliver the bandwidth needed for large language models. Without enough memory, the GPU becomes a race car stuck in traffic.

That dynamic has made SK Hynix the biggest winner of the AI memory boom. Demand for HBM continues to outpace supply, forcing suppliers to pursue aggressive capacity expansion, and allowing pricing to remain elevated. Micron (NASDAQ:MU) and Samsung are expanding production, but the industry still cannot manufacture enough advanced memory to satisfy hyperscale cloud providers.

Nvidia may sell the engine, but SK Hynix increasingly supplies the fuel that lets it perform.

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and SK Hynix didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Wall Street's Biggest Leveraged Bets Now Target SK Hynix

The shift in investor attention has become impossible to ignore.

According to market analysis firm KobeissiLetter, leveraged and inverse ETFs tied to SK Hynix now hold approximately $5.5 billion in assets -- the largest total for any individual stock globally, exceeding Micron's $5.1 billion and Nvidia's $4.8 billion. Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA), at $3.7 billion, is the largest non-chip-related stock. It means SK Hynix has become the focal point for traders looking to amplify short-term moves.

快速阅读

  • SK 海力士 (SKHY) 提供的高带宽内存成为每个人工智能加速器的瓶颈，从而将人工智能投资的叙述从 Nvidia 的 GPU 上转移开。
  • 与 SK 海力士相关的杠杆 ETF 持有 55 亿美元的资产，超过英伟达的 48 亿美元，使人工智能内存成为华尔街最热门的投机交易。
  • 杠杆ETF的每日重新平衡可能会在市场波动期间迅速放大损失，使其成为长期人工智能内存投资的不良工具。
  • 立即行动：2010 年致电 NVIDIA 的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 SK 海力士并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

人工智能投资进入新阶段。 在过去的两年里，话题一直围绕着 Nvidia（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）的图形处理器，因为它们推动了人工智能革命。 如今，瓶颈已经转移。 限制因素不再是公司可以设计多少 GPU，而是他们可以为其附加多少高带宽内存 (HBM)。

这种短缺推高了人工智能内存的价格，将内存股票推升至创纪录的估值，并改变了投机资本的流向。 市场的注意力不再集中在英伟达身上。 它已转移到 SK Hynix（纳斯达克股票代码：SKHY），这家韩国公司提供现在每个人工智能加速器所依赖的内存。

AI 的新瓶颈是内存，而不是 GPU

Nvidia 仍然在 AI 加速器领域占据主导地位，但其每一款旗舰芯片都依赖于 HBM 堆栈来提供大型语言模型所需的带宽。 如果没有足够的内存，GPU 就会成为陷入交通堵塞的赛车。

这种动力使 SK 海力士成为人工智能内存热潮的最大赢家。 HBM 的需求继续超过供应，迫使供应商积极扩张产能，并使价格保持在高位。 美光（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）和三星正在扩大生产，但该行业仍然无法制造足够的先进内存来满足超大规模云提供商的需求。

Nvidia 可能会出售该引擎，但 SK 海力士越来越多地供应让它发挥作用的燃料。

立即行动：2010 年致电 NVIDIA 的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 SK 海力士并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

华尔街最大的杠杆赌注现在瞄准了 SK 海力士

投资者注意力的转变已经不容忽视。

据市场分析公司KobeissiLetter称，与SK海力士相关的杠杆和反向ETF目前持有约55亿美元的资产——这是全球所有个股中资产总额最大的，超过美光科技的51亿美元和英伟达的48亿美元。 特斯拉（纳斯达克股票代码：TSLA）市值 37 亿美元，是最大的非芯片相关股票。 这意味着 SK 海力士已成为寻求放大短期走势的交易者的焦点。
